title: AYE KARBALA TUHI BATAAA MEHMAAN KYU'N PYAASA RAHA
body:
Jaane wila hai Karbala
Gham ki Dua hai Karbala
Ek raasta hai Karbala
Roshan hai kiska naqshe pa
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho hosala Azme Jawan
Mardaane hagq ka Imtihaan
Quraan ko di Kis ne zaban
Goonji kahan haq ki sada
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda hai mayaar e wafa
Ehsaan hai Abbas ka
Dariya jo hai behta hua
Sadqa hai uski pyaas ka
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehte hain jis ko Nainawa
Waada jaha'n poora hua
Hai naam ek maidaan ka
Ya sabr hai Shabbir ka
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar pa gira kya alam
Nanha gala teer e sitam
Kaise saha Sheh ne ye Gham
Jab aasra koi na tha
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
<<DIVIDER>>
Kab ahle haq ke sar jhuke
Sheh rag se katt gaye gale
Bayat jahan sajde karre
Aisa kahin Kaaba bana
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
<<DIVIDER>>
Noor e Sehr jab chaa gaya
Hur Shaah e Deen tak Aagaya
Tofeeq Haq se paagaya
Kis ki sada ka faiz tha
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar ka seena aur sina
Woh zabt Sarwar Allaman
Haathon pa hai Laasha jawaan
Aisa kahin dekha gaya
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaise huwa ye Saaniha
Noshah kyun ronda gaya
Kis haal me Laasha mila
Sheh ne aba me kya rakha
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas ne kya dukh sahe
Sarta qadam bas zakhm the
Baazu bhi us ke katt gaye
Kaise zameen par woh giraa
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar par koi saaya na tha
Thi khaak par Aale Aba
Din bhar me sab kuch lutt gaya
Ye kya hua kaise hua
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Sajdagaah e Aulia
Tasleem sab ne kar liya
Haq ki Azaa'n hai Karbala
Kis ne isse baaqi rakha
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
<<DIVIDER>>
Saathi na jab koi raha
Tanha tha Ibne Fatima
Tha zere khanjar jab gala
Kya Aalam e Tanhaai tha
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaam e Ghareeban ka Sama'n
Har simt shole aur dhuaa'n
Be aas saari Bibiyaa'n
Zainab huwi kyun Berida
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
<<DIVIDER>>
Akhtar thi Zainab ki fugha'n
Aaye hain Baba ab yaha'n
Kya kya karun un se baya'n
Tu hi bataaa Aye Karbala
<<MINI>>
Aye Karbala tuhi bataa
author: Akhtar Zaidi
